Ana: opened a short PR to clarify audit export TTL behaviour and update examples: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4702
Ana: TL;DR: default 90d tenant TTL, org minimums can apply, manual deletes follow SLA. added a tiny curl + python snippet and a note about expiring download URLs
Vik: can you paste the python snippet here? i want to check param names quickly
Ana: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.audit_exports.create(tenant_id='acct_999', export_format='export.v2', retention_days=90)
print(resp['download_url'])
```
Vik: looks good. change `retention_days` -> `ttl_days`? our other docs use ttl_* naming in places
legal-ops: wording check: avoid absolute phrases. suggest: "Exports are retained according to tenant-configured TTLs and applicable org-level retention policies; deletion requests are processed per the documented SLA."
Ana: updated wording per legal. also removed an internal note that leaked a dev URL. preview published: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/audit-exports/ttl-clarity.html
docs-bot: CI green :white_check_mark:
Vik: approved from docs side. merge when CI stays green
